status: No blocker found; corrected model proof passed; HTTP A/B pending
scope: 84 added production lines, a new audio full-causal kernel and family-specific dispatch only. Existing scalar, both vision kernels and corrected LayerNorm bodies match the baseline.

checks.bounds: n is validated nonzero and capped at 8192; query count<= 131072, causal key range 0..row, shared score storage n + 66 floats <= 33032 bytes.
checks.barriers: Early query return is CTA-uniform. Nonfinite max is shared/CTA-uniform. Higher output threads return only after the last barrier. Scores and stats are never reused until consumers synchronize.
checks.numerical: Scalar dimension/key/max/denominator order and unscaled dot before expf are preserved. Register output accumulation and constant rsqrt(64) still rely on actual compiled parity tests.
checks.dispatch: Q=KV16, HD64, strides1024, offsets0,separate pointers, full causal1, no sinks/group. Other layouts/windowed audio retain scalar fallback; knob 0 disables only this path.
checks.stream_and_errors: Launch uses ds4_current_stream and cudaGetLastError via cuda_ok. No persistent allocation, public ABI change or new decode state.
checks.alias_assumption: Production m2_mha allocates Q/K/V/output in distinct slots. Pointer checks exclude identical starts; arbitrary overlapping subviews are not newly supported.

tests: Actual wrapper OFF/default/ON, tails through8192, independent Q/K/V, mixed magnitudes, nonfinite behavior, guards/input immutability, invalid-input refusal and fallback regime assertions. Small double oracle is independent of scalar parity.

resource_tradeoff.arithmetic_note: FFMA and EX2 halve. FMUL/RCP rise because each output dimension normalizes weights; added shared storage and that arithmetic must be judged against the observed kernel/end-to-end gain.

limits: No new GPU run in this review. Historical isolated target body is unchanged. All six corrected-baseline model proofs now match exactly; HTTP qualification remains pending.
